About This Book关于本书

97 Things Every Data Engineer Should Know: Collective Wisdom from the Experts. Edited by Tobias Macey. Publisher: O'Reilly Media, 2021. ISBN-13: 978-1098112361.

《数据工程师应知的 97 件事：专家集体智慧》。Tobias Macey 编。O'Reilly Media 2021 年出版。ISBN-13：978-1098112361。

This bilingual edition is a community reading aid: every paragraph of the original English text is followed by its Chinese translation. Code blocks remain in English, technical terms are kept in English on first appearance with a Chinese gloss in parentheses, and page marks indicate the original PDF page number.

本双语版是一种社区阅读辅助：英文原文每段之后紧跟中文译文。代码块保留英文，技术术语首次出现时保留英文原词并括注中文，页码标记指示原 PDF 页码。

Preface (Excerpt)前言（节选）

Data engineering has rapidly emerged as the discipline that underpins the broader field of data science. As the field evolves, the practices, tools, and mental models that effective practitioners rely on have also changed. This book collects short, opinionated essays from dozens of practicing data engineers, architects, and leaders—each sharing one thing they wish someone had told them earlier.

数据工程迅速崛起为支撑整个数据科学领域的学科。随着该领域演进，高效从业者所依赖的实践、工具和心智模型也在变化。本书收集了数十位一线数据工程师、架构师和领导者的短小而带观点的文章——每人分享一件他们希望早点有人告诉自己的事。

The 97 pieces are independent: read them in any order, dip in and out, or read straight through. They are organized here into 10 merged chapters (Things 1–10, 11–20, …, 91–97) so that each chapter is a self-contained offline HTML file.

这 97 篇短文相互独立：可按任意顺序读、跳读或通读。在这里被合并为 10 个章节（第 1–10、11–20、…、91–97 篇），每章是一个自包含的离线 HTML 文件。
